subject: general
question: Which of the following in NOT a GST rate slab in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In India, the GST (Goods and Services Tax) is levied at various rate slabs.
 
• The GST rate slabs are 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%.
 
• The rate of 0.1% is not a standard GST rate slab in India.
 
• Common GST rates include 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28% for different categories of goods and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **GST (Goods and Services Tax)**

 
 
• GST is an indirect tax that has replaced many indirect taxes in India such as the excise duty, VAT, services tax, etc.
 
• It is a single tax on the supply of goods and services, right from the manufacturer to the consumer.
 
• GST is categorized into CGST (Central GST), SGST (State GST), IGST (Integrated GST), and UTGST (Union Territory GST).
 
• The GST Council, which includes representatives from the central and state governments, determines the tax rates, rules, and regulations.
 
 
 
• **GST Rate Slabs**
 
 
• There are five primary GST rate slabs in India: 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%.
 
• Essential items are either exempt or taxed at a lower rate, while luxury items and sin goods attract the highest rate of 28%.
 
• The GST rates are determined based on the type of goods and services provided.
 
 
 
• **GST Council**
 
 
• The GST Council is a constitutional body for making recommendations to the Union and State Government on issues related to GST.
 
• The council is chaired by the Union Finance Minister and includes the Finance Ministers of all the states.
 
• The council determines the tax rate, exemptions, and thresholds for the application of GST.
